newsitem.title: ITALY: EU seen confirming Alitalia stake sales.
newsitem.headline: EU seen confirming Alitalia stake sales.

text.p: The European Commission will ask Alitalia to sell a 35 percent stake in Hungarian airline Malev and other holdings when it publishes its opinion on the troubled firm's recapitalisation, industry sources said.
The Commission is due to publish its recommendations on July 14 or 15, Alitalia officials and the transport ministry said.
Italian news agency Ansa reported on Thursday that the Italian government's recapitalisation plan would be given the go ahead on condition Alitalia sold certain holdings.
Asked to comment on the report, an Alitalia spokesman said: "We have heard nothing. We are waiting for the response from Brussels on July 14 or 15."
A transport ministry spokesman said he believed a meeting on Alitalia was due to take place in Brussels on Thursday.

The European Commission ruled last month that a government request to inject some three trillion lire into the loss-making airline should be treated as state aid and therefore subject to strict controls.
It has already decided that the government, which controls Alitalia through state holding IRI, can only inject 2.75 trillion lire into airline coffers.
